Final Environmental Impact Statement Kendall Square Urban Renewal Project Cambridge, Mass.
The issues that were identified in the DEIS and circulated for public comment did not reveal that the project should be modified or revised. All agencies that responded to the DEIS concurred with the plan or had no comment to make. All comments received have been replied to here-in. The alternatives considered in the DEIS are summerized here-in as "Exhibit" BB."
Therefore, it is the decision of this offfic not to republish the EIS, but to prepare the FEIS as an appendix to the DEIS. This FEIS contains the comments and replies, and a revised Amendment No. 1 as "Exhibit AA" to the Urban Renewal Flan. Also HUD's recommendations and decisions are incorporated here—in.
